markets.rules_primary: If Atlanta is the team to make the 2nd Overall Pick in the 2027 Pro Football Draft, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves to Yes based on the team that makes the 2nd selection in the draft. If a team initially owns the rights to the 2nd overall pick but trades that pick to another team, the market will resolve to Yes for the team that ultimately makes the selection, not the team that originally held the pick.
